title: At Drop (On site, unloading)
voice_questions: I'm calling to check on your delivery at [receiver address] - have you arrived and checked in?
What dock number did they assign you?
Has unloading started, and how long did they quote you for completion?
Only ask if delivery type is live unload and lumper field is not 'N': Do you need a lumper code?
If they need lumper code, ask how much and what payment type do they accept?

Arrived_at_receiver.description: Whether the driver has arrived at the receiver address

Checked_in.description: Whether the driver has checked in at the receiver

Dock_number.description: The dock number assigned to the driver

Unloading_duration_estimate.description: Estimated time to complete unloading as quoted to the driver

Lumper_code_needed.description: Whether the driver needs a lumper code (only applicable for live unload)

Lumper_amount.description: Amount for lumper service if needed

Lumper_payment_type.description: Payment type accepted for lumper service if needed
